profileLifecycle.proposed: Source-bound bundles may refine this profile before productionReady becomes true. Every historical bundle remains immutable and is identified by its source commit and manifest digest.
profileLifecycle.stable: Once productionReady is true, incompatible schema or semantic changes require a new major contract profile.

contractVersionVsRelease.contractProfile: Identifies the wire generation. While this profile remains proposed, each source-bound bundle is an immutable revision; after stabilization, incompatible changes require a new major profile.
contractVersionVsRelease.implementationVersion: Carried by the producing implementation (for example the Coven daemon release) and is independent of the contract profile. Clients must never infer contract semantics from an implementation version.
contractVersionVsRelease.producerIdentity: Event and receipt envelopes carry the producing implementation's identity and version alongside the contract profile.

wireNotes: All objects in this profile are JSON per draft 2020-12 schemas in this directory.
Digests and any future signatures are computed over RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON, never over ad-hoc serialization.
Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision (for example 2026-08-30T09:00:00.000Z), matching the #816 store encoding.

Durable schedule timezones are canonical `utc` or exact IANA TZIDs. Legacy `local` is resolved before persistence and is not a durable v1 value; on Unix, an effective TZ override must itself be `utc` or an exact IANA TZID and otherwise fails closed.
